On what actually has to be public: the values Tebex needs to pay you are
given to Tebex, not printed on the listing. What a storefront must show a
consumer is a separate question and depends on where you are trading from,
so the brand and the legal name are two fields here rather than one.
I am not a lawyer and this file is not legal advice.

$notes.LEGAL NAME: The name you would sign a contract with. A personal name is normal for a sole trader.
$notes.CONFIRMED BRAND: What the listing says it is sold by. This is the one most buyers will ever see.
$notes.BUSINESS CONTACT ADDRESS / JURISDICTION: At minimum the country. Whether a full address must appear publicly depends on where you trade and whether you are a company; a registered office or service address is the usual way to avoid publishing a home one.
$notes.SUPPORT CHANNEL: One monitored inbox or ticket channel. Tebex's Creator Agreement section 4 requires monitored contact and a 72-hour first response. It does not have to contain your name.
$notes.PRIVACY EMAIL: May be the same as the support channel.
$notes.EXACT PACKAGE: What a buyer receives on purchase, named precisely.
$notes.DEFINED PERIOD OR OBJECTIVE CRITERIA: How long support correspondence is kept.
$notes.SPECIFIC PURPOSES AND LAWFUL BASIS: Why any buyer data is held.
$notes.PEOPLE/PROVIDERS: Who else touches it. Tebex at minimum.
